title: Pure Skull Servant
summary: The Skull Servant ('Wight') archetype is a Level 1 Zombie graveyard-stacking OTK deck centered around King of the Skull Servants, which gains 1000 ATK for every 'Skull Servant' and 'King of the Skull Servants' in your GY! Every Wight monster (Wightbaking, Wightprince, Wightprincess, Wightlord, Wightmare, and The Lady in Wight) treats its name as 'Skull Servant' while in the GY. Send Wightbaking to the GY (via Uni-Zombie, One for One, or Linkuriboh) to search Wightprince + Wightlord and immediately discard Wightprince—which sends both Skull Servant and The Lady in Wight from your Deck to the GY! Discard Wightlord to mill up to 5+ more cards and banish it to revive a 10,000+ ATK King of the Skull Servants protected from battle and Spells/Traps by The Lady in Wight!

allow.Uni-Zombie: Core Level 3 DARK Zombie Tuner starter: discards Wightbaking or Wightprince from your hand AND sends a second Wightbaking or Wightprince directly from your Deck to the GY—triggering up to 6 Skull Servant names in a single Normal Summon!
allow.Mezuki: Level 4 EARTH Zombie (can be sent from Deck to GY by Uni-Zombie or milled by Wightlord) that banishes itself from your GY to Special Summon King of the Skull Servants or The Lady in Wight from your GY!
allow.Burial from a Different Dimension: Quick-Play Spell that returns up to 3 banished monsters (such as Wightprince + Skull Servant + The Lady in Wight banished to summon King of the Skull Servants!) back to your GY—instantly giving King of the Skull Servants +3000 ATK!
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards Wightprince or Wightbaking to Special Summon King of the Skull Servants or Wightbaking directly from your Deck.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Wightbaking or Wightprince directly from your Deck to the GY to start your full combo.
allow.Linkuriboh: Link-1 Cyberse monster that links off a Normal Summoned Level 1 Wightbaking or Wightprince to immediately trigger its GY effect!
allow.Relinquished Anima: Link-1 Spellcaster that links off Level 1 Wightbaking or Wightprince while absorbing an opponent's monster in front of the Extra Monster Zone.
allow.Avendread Savior: Link-2 DARK Zombie that sends Wightbaking or Wightprince from your Deck to the GY during damage calculation to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK and recover a Zombie from GY.
allow.Vampire Sucker: Link-2 DARK Zombie that draws 1 card every time a Zombie (like King of the Skull Servants!) is revived from the GY.
allow.Immortal Dragon: Level 6 DARK Zombie Synchro Tuner (made with Uni-Zombie + Level 3 The Lady in Wight / Wightprincess) that sends Wightbaking or Wightprince from your Deck to the GY on Synchro Summon!

main: King of the Skull Servants

Signature Level 1 DARK Zombie boss (? ATK / 0 DEF): gains 1000 ATK for each 'Skull Servant' and 'King of the Skull Servants' in your GY (regularly reaching 8,000 to 15,000+ ATK!); when destroyed by battle, banishes 1 other Skull Servant or King from your GY to immediately revive itself!
Wightbaking

Core Level 1 DARK Zombie engine: counts as 'Skull Servant' in the GY; if a Level 3 or lower Zombie(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can discard this card instead; if this card is sent to the GY, adds 2 monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand that mention 'Skull Servant' or are 'Skull Servant', then discards 1 card (discarding Wightprince!)!
Wightprince

Core Level 1 DARK Zombie engine: counts as 'Skull Servant' in the GY; if this card is sent to the GY, you can send 1 'Skull Servant' AND 1 'The Lady in Wight' from your hand and/or Deck to the GY; and banishes itself + 2 'Skull Servant' from your GY to Special Summon 'King of the Skull Servants' directly from your Deck!
Wightlord

Core Level 1 LIGHT Zombie engine (Legacy of Destruction): counts as 'Skull Servant' in the GY; sends itself from your hand or field to the GY to send cards from the top of your Deck to the GY up to the number of 'Skull Servant' and 'King of the Skull Servants' in your GY; and banishes itself from your GY to Special Summon 1 'Skull Servant' or 'King of the Skull Servants' from your GY!
Wightprincess

Level 3 LIGHT Zombie: counts as 'Skull Servant' in the GY; when Normal or Special Summoned, sends 1 'Wightprince' directly from your Deck to the GY; and sends itself from your hand or field to the GY as a Quick Effect to reduce all monsters on the field by 300 ATK/DEF x their Level/Rank (while leaving Level 1 King of the Skull Servants at -300 and dropping opposing Level 8/10 bosses by -2400/-3000 ATK!)!
Wightmare

Level 1 DARK Zombie: counts as 'Skull Servant' in the GY; discards itself from your hand to either return 1 of your banished 'Skull Servant' or 'Wightmare' to your GY (restoring +1000 ATK to King of the Skull Servants!), OR Special Summon 1 of your banished 'The Lady in Wight' or 'King of the Skull Servants' directly to your field!
The Lady in Wight

Level 3 DARK Zombie (0 ATK / 2200 DEF): counts as 'Skull Servant' in the GY, is sent from Deck to GY by Wightprince, and while face-up on the field, makes all Level 3 or lower Zombie monsters you control (including King of the Skull Servants!) indestructible by battle and completely unaffected by Spell/Trap Cards and effects!
Skull Servant
Iconic original Level 1 DARK Zombie Normal Monster (300 ATK / 200 DEF): required in 3 copies so Wightprince can always send a real 'Skull Servant' + 'The Lady in Wight' from your Deck to the GY!
Uni-Zombie
1-card starter: discards Wightbaking or Wightprince from your hand AND sends another Wightbaking or Wightprince from your Deck to the GY.
Mezuki
Banishes itself from your GY (milled by Wightlord or sent by Uni-Zombie) to revive King of the Skull Servants or The Lady in Wight.
Burial from a Different Dimension
Returns 3 banished Skull Servant / Wight monsters to your GY as a Quick-Play Spell for an instant +3000 ATK boost during the Battle Phase!
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: discards Wightprince to Special Summon King of the Skull Servants or Wightbaking from your Deck.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Wightbaking from your Deck to the GY to search Wightprince + Wightlord.
